findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: clearinghouse_precheck, road_investor_group · Private data: who_owns_home, lender_marks, exposure_workspace, exposure_dbgap, perf_firm, contractor_credit, clearinghouse_precheck, clearinghouse_record, clearinghouse_program, road_screen_purchase · Public sink: lender_marks, perf_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: clearinghouse_precheck, road_investor_group · Private data: who_owns_home, lender_marks, exposure_workspace, exposure_dbgap, perf_firm, contractor_credit, clearinghouse_precheck, clearinghouse_record, clearinghouse_program, road_screen_purchase · Public sink: lender_marks, perf_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
